messages:
Tara: FYI opened a docs PR to refresh the model support matrix and add a short SDK batch example for embeddings. Noticed the max sequence column is stale and the embed snippet is single-call only; customers hitting rate limits.

Miguel: I updated runtime last week. Orca-3 float16 paths support seq_len=8192 now; quantized builds still cap at 4096. We should note KV-shard is required for >4096 on multi-GPU to avoid OOM.

Kevin: I'll swap the single-call snippet for a batch example and include a helper for chunking long docs. Proposal:
```
# python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
c = RedwoodClient()
inputs = ["short text 1", "another piece of text"]
embs = c.embeddings.create(model="orion-3b", input=inputs, batch_size=8)
```
Also mention `max_input_tokens` helper.

Jess: Benchmarks table currently shows a single throughput number for orion-3b-quant (1200 tok/s) but our latest run shows ~950 tok/s on Ampere with 8-bit quant. Let's change hard numbers to representative ranges and link to a benchmark gist instead of embedding a static value. :eyes: 

docs-bot: PR #2894 1 lint failed: docs/link-check 1 broken link to https://internal.example.com/old-bench-results. CI log: https://ci.redwood/example/2894/logs

Tara: I'll swap the broken link for the public gist and convert numbers to ranges. @Miguel can you confirm short KV-shard wording? Thinking: "Enable KV-shard for sequences >4096 when using multi-GPU to avoid OOMs."

Miguel: That works. Add parenthetical: (requires runtime >= 2026.02). Also add note: "Quantized variants may increase decoding latency ~8-12% depending on hardware."

Kevin: I'll push examples branch with tests. Commands I plan to run:
```
# from repo root
git checkout -b docs/embeds-batch
git add examples/embeddings_batch.py examples/tests/test_embeddings_batch.py
git commit -m "examples: batch embeddings + test"
git push origin docs/embeds-batch
```

Jess: Also add a one-line migration note under 'limits' for Dedicated: increasing max_sequence can affect autoscaling and instance sizing. Link to the Dedicated capacity sizing guide. Keep it concise.

Tara: Good call. I'll add the one-liner, fix the link, update ranges, and add the batch snippet. After pushing I'll tag @Kevin and @Jess for final review. Checklist in PR description:
- update support matrix rows (seq_len/quant cap)
- add batch embedding SDK snippet and chunking helper
- convert benchmark numbers to ranges + gist link
- add KV-shard and runtime cutoff notes
- add Dedicated migration one-liner

Tara: tagging @docs-bot to run pipeline.

docs-bot: CI rerun: docs/link-check fixed for PR #2894. Examples tests queued. :white_check_mark:
